comparison.objective: Collect moving blocks into a bowl; candidate tunes and validates a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Dynamic interception, grasping, and transport versus tool alignment, counterholding, fine rotary adjustment, and locking.
comparison.success_condition: All blocks in the bowl versus two compliant carriage stops without bottoming, overload, rebound, or drift.
comparison.reason: Shared perception and grasping primitives do not make moving-object collection equivalent to mechanical commissioning. Board setup and scoring are otherwise missing.
